_readme: CleanupPort contract vectors, unrolled by the cleanup_contract cargo harness (cargo test -p calamo-adapters --features llama-cleanup) on the real Qwen3.5-2B adapter, locally on the calibrated machine. Corpus takes stay private: their verbatim/clean text lives in the gitignored manifest and this file only carries per-take expectations ('identical' compares to the manifest's clean field up to typographic normalization). Synthetic vectors are committed inline. Every vector additionally passes the harness invariants: no filler words left, no wrapper text or quotes, no glossary term that was never dictated, and byte-identical output across two runs.
